note: No public queryable zoning district layer found for Muskogee County or the City of Muskogee. The City's planning page says its zoning map is moving to ArcGIS ('coming soon', 04/27/2026) and gives only a PDF legend. The county's ArcGIS services (Muskogee_County_Data) hold only boundaries, wards and districts, no zoning. A Fort Gibson zoning layer (FtGibsonGIS) requires a token. Regrid parcel zoning is a paid third-party product, not an official source. Searches of ArcGIS Hub/Online and the county/city sites found no service.
